bootstrap.implementation: shared g0-power-0112.py complete_replicate_interaction + decision_path: 0103 mean/strict-bound terminal path with complete-replicate resampling

correlation_envelope.model: Gaussian-copula threshold with shared session-level latent normal shock
correlation_envelope.decision_rule: evaluate every G0 criterion at every member; the empirical worst member per criterion decides the sweep PASS

g0.outcome_proxy: Bernoulli task-level manifestation-fail fraction; maximum-variance [0,1] proxy compatible with published means only
g0.saturation_definition: all matrix-engine LATE task fractions equal 1 in every deciding replicate; SATURATED precedes CI terminals

g1_early_mean_tolerance.derivation: S=5 S-null 2.5%-97.5% early-mean deviations from the anchors across every rho member, rounded upward to the next 0.005

capture.authorship: script-authored under the orchestrator by the pinned capture script

field_mapping.value: compact JSON of weekly_all, raw seven_day resets_at, server Date, and raw_sha256
field_mapping.panel_sha256: sha256 of the raw endpoint response body
field_mapping.auxiliary: Fable weekly_scoped percent and session percent

capture.panel_sha256: sha256 of the raw endpoint response body
capture.reset_at_canonicalization: UTC, round to nearest minute (>=30 s up), +60 s; observed sub-second jitter straddles the second boundary (receipts usage-jitter-A/B 2026-09-02)
refusals: raw reset mismatch or invalid timestamp
capture.lock_rule: seven_day.locked_reason is null and any weekly_all locked_reason present is null; is_active and severity are ignored
capture.auxiliary_rule: one weekly_scoped limit whose scope.model.display_name is Fable and one session limit supply integer percents; absence supplies null and duplicate matches refuse

usage_evidence.reset_handling: A changed canonical reset_at with used_percent not above the prior capture starts one new epoch (either direction); a change with a rise refuses; reused epochs refuse; the manifest-pinned calendar permits at most W transitions per root.
usage_evidence.refusal: missing, malformed, stale, non-monotone within an epoch, or non-percent /usage readout refuses before any manifest write

budget_gate.subsequent_bound_function: ceil(1.25 * max(m6_sweep_1, m6_sweep_2, m6_sweep_3 aggregate transport tokens))

calibration.program: driver-shaped smoke session per engine in registered order on the pinned smoke task pair; receipts remain under the launch out-dir
calibration.draw: inputTokens + outputTokens + cacheCreationInputTokens + cacheReadInputTokens summed over all calibration receipts
calibration.top_up_rule: the launcher-owned exclusive bracket requires P1/P2 equal after Q=600 seconds, then runs same-order three-session units; if settled delta_percent is less than 4 it continues through at most 36 sessions per attempt and 36 per epoch across attempts, and at either cap or whenever no further complete registered unit fits accepts only a full calendar closure (delta zero refuses CALIBRATION_UNIDENTIFIABLE; a failed closure refuses VENUE_OVER_BUDGET)
calibration.settlement_rule: the launcher captures S1 at least 180 seconds after the final receipt and S2 125 seconds later; S1/S2 must have equal used_percent and the same reset epoch; it durably records calibration and closure inputs before marking an attempt settled, so restart publication is idempotent
calibration.exclusive_bracket: from P1 through the final settlement capture, the launcher is the only permitted account-consuming surface; the orchestrator is idle and other sessions are stopped; immediately after P1 completes it atomically records the attempt epoch as P1's canonical reset_at before any unit starts; current_week_fable_percent is invariant at P2, every intermediate bracket capture, S1, and S2
calibration.cross_epoch_carry: forbidden; every reset epoch has a fresh calibration before its first gate
calibration.tpp: tpp_cal=floor(D/(delta_percent+1)); each same-epoch completed sweep with delta_percent >= 1 adds floor(draw/(delta_percent+1)); tpp_gate is the current epoch minimum without a floor clamp

meter_charge_assumption.statement: meter_charge = wN*(input+output+cacheCreate) + wR*cacheRead with 0 <= wR <= wN, engine-invariant and stable within a reset epoch; calibration share <= 0.973 <= completed-sweep share makes tpp_cal conservative

mix_constraint.partial_prefix_rule: completed sweeps only; partial receipt prefixes are exempt

accounting.derivation: The append-only attempt ledger charges started units x 3 sessions, including interrupted attempts; an interruption before P1 has no epoch and zero started units, while every persisted post-P1 epoch is counted as a reset transition. 36 sessions per attempt and 36 sessions per epoch across all attempts give 36 sessions per epoch x (W_max + 1) epochs, where W_max=6, for the 252-session root cap

full_session_bound_transport_tokens.derivation: ceil(742182 * 5 / 4), where 742182 is max over the six observed fire-bracket sessions of that session's two smoke receipt transport totals (claude-sonnet-5 calibration-1: 370829 + 371353)

full_bracket_wall_ms.derivation: The observed six-session bracket ran 1106253.379 ms from P1 2026-09-02T01:18:54.483015Z to S2 2026-09-02T01:37:20.736394Z. Its two 180s+125s settlement waits consume 610000 ms, leaving 496253.379 ms; ceil(496253.379) = 496254 ms for one six-session model/capture group. A 36-session future epoch has six such groups: 6*496254 + Q=600000 + 12*(180000+125000) = 7237524 ms.

settlement.entry_shape: reset_at plus exactly two usage captures; no calibration sessions and no tpp-chain entry
settlement.rule: captures have equal used_percent, are at least 120 seconds apart, and the first capture is at least 180 seconds after the latest recorded account-consuming calibration receipt, probe call, or sweep receipt including partial and VOID attempts
settlement.admission_rule: the latest settlement (or calibration settlement) second capture is the comparison baseline; no account-consuming call may follow that settlement first capture, with exactly one selected event subtracted per capture identity; the CLI-supplied gate evidence must be a new final same-epoch capture with strictly later observed_at and used_percent equal to the comparison baseline (settlement-stale otherwise)
settlement.resume_order: run probes first, record the settlement pair second, take a fresh final capture third, then invoke the launcher with that final capture; every probe observed_at precedes the settlement first capture

closure_check.rule: the shared calendar simulator places every remaining nominal sweep burn and reserve, replay-event burn and reserve, probe call, registered active-wave bound, reset wait, and a 36-session worst-case calibration before every new epoch on the canonical 168-hour reset timeline; it chooses the smallest W <= W_max that keeps every epoch strictly below 100 and ends no later than created_at + W*168 hours

calendar.formula: iter0112-calendar-v2: shared deterministic placement on canonical reset_at + n*168h boundaries
calendar.expiry_transition: At or after the manifest-pinned expiry, before launch or resume work, write terminal WALL_CLOCK_EXPIRED; scorer returns UNSCORED.

charged_accounting.derivation: Proposal. 32 maximum block attempts = 20 complete replicates + 12 replay slots (4 observed limit events across m3/m4/m5/m6 × 3 pinned lanes concurrently voidable per event). 32 × 6 = 192 session-equivalent allowance. Worst-case transport exposure is 32 × 40,058,253 = 1,281,864,096; the strict per-sweep fire-time gate is the identifiable operational bound because the weekly denominator was unmeasurable at freeze. Calendar headroom is derived per closure receipt as pinned expiry minus simulated calendar_end for that receipt's W.
charged_accounting.exhaustion_transition: A proposed started block at count 32 writes terminal CHARGED_ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED before process launch; scorer returns UNSCORED.

evidence_precedence: usage headroom plus all fresh per-engine probes
resume_oracle.disagreement_rule: Fresh headroom evidence and every required engine probe license resume even if a prior 429 reset is future-dated; a reset receipt alone never licenses resume. Any missing, stale, failed, or wrong-model probe leaves REPLACEMENT_PENDING.
resume_oracle.probe_success_predicate: returncode == 0; strict whole-stdout JSON object; is_error is not true; modelUsage has exactly the requested engine
resume_oracle.probe_budget_derivation: Proposal. 12 replay launches × 3 registered per-engine calls × 1 session equivalent per call = 36 session equivalents; the manifest records and caps actual consumed calls, not oracle count.

exact_envelope.result: API Error: Unable to connect to API (ENOTFOUND)

driver_evidence.strict_parser: json.loads of the whole stdout byte stream; no suffix recovery; reopen only after exact pinned CLI under registered concurrency reproduces the suffix defect

aup_refusal.predicate: is_error is true; subtype is success; terminal_reason is api_error; stop_reason is refusal; api_error_status is null; modelUsage has exactly the requested engine
aup_refusal.disposition: scoreable failed row; neither catastrophic nor custody-broken solely because of this receipt

venue_tolerance.designation_rule: first complete transport-clean attempt, mechanically and outcome-blind
venue_tolerance.void_classes: Only numeric api_error_status 429 or 529, text-manifested limits when api_error_status is null and the registered limit_text_regex matches stderr, or the exact ENOTFOUND envelope plus fresh host-origin control-resolution failure are void-eligible. Generic connection failures, task setup failures, runner OSError/timeouts, and AUP refusals remain scoreable or structural as separately registered.
